question: Which three Uniswap v4 pool IDs paired with token 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 had the greatest swap volume in that token on chain 1 during the last 24 hours? Return bytes32[] pool IDs.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.source: Use only PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90. Discover pool currency0/currency1 from its Initialize logs up to toBlock.
definitions.metric: For pools containing 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2, sum the absolute signed Swap amount for that currency over inclusive fromBlock..toBlock in raw token units. Count each canonical log once. Keep positive-volume pools only.
definitions.ordering: Sort by descending volume, ties by ascending numeric bytes32 pool ID. Return up to 3 unique IDs; return [] only for a complete scan with no eligible pools.
